events.verdict: Horford (BOS) is firming up in Lillard's (MIL) path on the perimeter, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Middleton (MIL) moves towards the basket and comes together with White (BOS) while the shot travels through the air, and the contact is marginal.
Lopez (MIL) legally contests Horford's (BOS) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) firms up in Holiday's (BOS) path and does not delivery any illegal contact when setting the pick.

Horford's (BOS) right hand grazes Middleton's (MIL) shoulder as he raises his arm up into a vertical position.  The brush contact that occurs immediately prior to Horford blocking the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Holiday (BOS) wraps his right arm around Antetokounmpo's (MIL) waist and initiates contact that affects his shot near the rim.
Horford (BOS) is already in Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Middleton (MIL) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.

White (BOS) momentarily rests his hand on Lillard's (MIL) front as the pick is set, and White immediately removes his hand as marginal contact occurs prior to the start of Lillard's upward shooting motion.
White (BOS) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Holiday (BOS) firms up in Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Lopez (MIL) brings his hand to rest on Tatum's (BOS) side during his drive towards the basket, and the contact prior to the release of Tatum's pass is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) firms up in Brown's (BOS) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the screen.
Middleton (MIL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.

Replay review of the foul called on Brown (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Brown is drawn into the air by Middleton (MIL) and applies his left hand to Middleton's side.  Additionally, Brown is turning towards Middleton and initiates body contact with Middleton's side during his upward shooting motion. A shooting foul is correctly called on this play.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
Middleton (MIL) and White (BOS) come together at the same spot off ball, and the contact is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) commits a take foul on Holiday (BOS).
White (BOS) and Middleton (MIL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball, and the ensuing contact is marginal.
